subject.title: feat(plugins): expose resolved agentId on plugin command context

question: Should OpenClaw accept resolver-backed `PluginCommandContext.agentId` as public Plugin SDK API for command handlers?
rationale: The implementation is narrow, but adding or changing a public SDK context field commits third-party plugin authors to stable semantics that automation should not decide alone.

options.title: Accept and document `ctx.agentId`
options.body: Approve the optional resolver-backed command context field, require a short SDK docs note, and merge after refresh and checks.

options.title: Keep only existing explicit-agent behavior
options.body: Decline the resolver-backed semantics for now and keep current main's narrower explicit `params.agentId` context behavior.

options.title: Decline the public field
options.body: Close the PR if maintainers do not want command handlers to receive agent identity as public SDK context.

recommendation.title: Accept and document `ctx.agentId`
recommendation.body: Approve the optional resolver-backed command context field, require a short SDK docs note, and merge after refresh and checks.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the adjacent command-context session identity contract in the same runtime and type surface.
